question: On each surface that reads a users PROFILE row's allowedFirmIds, what does no row, no attribute, an empty list, a list of firms, the literal ALL, and a malformed value mean today?

surfaces.no_row: EVERY_FIRM (line 376-377 returns None,None = no scope; a failed or ambiguous lookup is REFUSED 403, lines 373-381)
surfaces.the_literal_ALL: NO_FIRM (inside a list it is a plain id that matches nothing, per the docstring lines 363-364; a bare string ALL is not a list and is REFUSED, line 390); how the frozenset is applied downstream was not opened
surfaces.malformed: REFUSED (line 390, 403 firm scope malformed; includes a list with a non-string or empty member)

surfaces.surface: investor-reporting internal firm reader _internal_allowed_firms (applies only when a firm other than the caller's own is selected)
surfaces.no_row: EVERY_FIRM (line 1152-1153 returns None = unchanged, any registered firm selectable)
surfaces.empty_list: EVERY_FIRM (line 1161-1163, None = unchanged; a list of only blank strings also reads as empty)
surfaces.list_of_firms: THE_LISTED_FIRMS (line 1166; selected firm outside it is refused FIRM_BINDING, line 1228-1229)
surfaces.the_literal_ALL: REFUSED (line 1164-1165 raises; bare string ALL raises at 1157-1158; caller turns a raise into FIRM_BINDING, 1226-1227)
surfaces.malformed: REFUSED (non-list or non-string member raises, 1157-1160; any read error raises)

surfaces.surface: investor-reporting service firm reader _service_allowed_firms (applies only when a firm other than the caller's own is selected)
surfaces.empty_list: NO_FIRM (line 1130-1134 yields an empty list, so no other firm matches)
surfaces.list_of_firms: THE_LISTED_FIRMS (line 1130-1134; a comma-separated string is also split, 1128-1129)
surfaces.the_literal_ALL: EVERY_FIRM (line 1126-1127 returns None only for the string ALL; an ALL member inside a list is just an id, line 1134, so NO_FIRM there)
surfaces.malformed: NO_FIRM (line 1132-1133 and 1135-1136 return [] = restricts everything; any read error likewise)

surfaces.surface: partners-data lambda, consumer of the portal authorizer's context string
surfaces.no_row: NOT_READ (what the authorizer emits for no row is in the authorizer, not found in this checkout)
surfaces.row_without_the_attribute: NOT_READ for what the authorizer emits; if the context value arrives empty or absent: REFUSED 401 (line 1698-1700) unless the caller's firm is opal-capital, then EVERY_FIRM (line 1688-1690)
surfaces.empty_list: NOT_READ for what the authorizer emits; an empty context string behaves as the absent case above
surfaces.list_of_firms: THE_LISTED_FIRMS (context is read as a comma-separated string, lines 308-310; the authorizer's join was not read)
surfaces.malformed: NOT_READ (no validation of the string seen; a non-matching string lists no firm)

where_the_three_surfaces_disagree: no_row: ticket service EVERY_FIRM; investor-reporting internal EVERY_FIRM; investor-reporting service NO_FIRM
row_without_the_attribute: ticket service EVERY_FIRM; investor-reporting internal EVERY_FIRM; investor-reporting service NO_FIRM
empty_list: ticket service EVERY_FIRM; investor-reporting internal EVERY_FIRM; investor-reporting service NO_FIRM
the_literal_ALL: ticket service NO_FIRM (in a list) or REFUSED (bare string); investor-reporting internal REFUSED; investor-reporting service EVERY_FIRM
malformed: ticket service and investor-reporting internal REFUSED; investor-reporting service NO_FIRM (fail closed without a refusal)
what_was_not_read: The portal authorizer itself: no folder under infra/aws/lambda carries an authorizer name and the only context consumer found (partners-data) says the authorizer lives elsewhere (a portal-authorizer function), so what it puts in context for no row, empty list or malformed is NOT_READ. The ticket service's use of the returned frozenset (_in_profile_scope) and the other allowedFirmIds hits (data_refresh, advi/billing-read, intake/uploads.py, _scope/interactive_access.py, ycharts current_authority.py, canonical_profile_reads.py) were not opened. The ticket service no-row cell is the base state; TO-R7-nr1 is the order that changes it to a refusal.
